features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — No migrations. Two things in the data change shape, additively: instalment shares generated from this version on carry a new key, «titolarita_alla», in their snapshot (it states how ownership was resolved: «atemporale»), and the relations between units and people go through a dedicated model that exposes the id of the ownership row — editing an ownership now writes per row and writes nothing when nothing changed; with one row per person the effect is nil.

WHO THE OWNER IS, DECIDED IN ONE PLACE — The question «who holds this unit» had twenty answers scattered across twenty points of the program (allocation engine, balances, debt position, importer, checkers, printouts), each with its own hand-written filter. From today one service answers, RisolutoreTitolari, with the rule as it has always been: whoever is marked active counts. Release gate passed: allocation identical to the cent across the whole suite, 2,516 green tests without changing a line of the existing ones. It is the first block of the ownership-transfer package of 1.11: this version installs the resolver, the next one brings time into the calculation.

FOUR ROLE LOOKUPS MADE DETERMINISTIC — Instalment plan detail, instalment collection, debt position and the joint-balance check used to read a person's role on a unit as «the first row that comes up». With one row per person it is identical to before; when the next version allows two periods for the same person, they will pick the active row first, then the most recent.

THE ACCRUAL PERIOD EXISTS, AND IS DELIBERATELY IGNORED FOR NOW — The engine accepts an accrual period as a trailing argument (a date range; a single date is a one-day period), carries it to the resolver, and the resolver does not use it. No caller passes it yet: it is the rail the next version will run pro-rata on.
NOTHING CHANGES ON SCREEN — No page, guide or printout differs: both allocation printouts, the debt position and the unit ownership pages return the same data as before.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO — Ownership transfers are not handled yet: start and end dates of an ownership are still recorded and shown but enter no calculation. No pro-rata, no «Register transfer», no per-period history: that is 1.11.0-beta.31. On the chart of accounts page the name next to an invoice line is still every registered owner, including former ones: recorded, to be closed with periods. One question about the importer stays open in the roadmap: today it accepts the same person in two roles on the same unit.

DOCUMENTATION — The ownership-transfer design was re-read in full against the code and reconciled with a forum report (the same two scenarios already recorded in August): the accrual criterion is now written once and the right way round — resolution date for extraordinary expenses, accrual period for ordinary ones —, the resolution date will be asked for, not inferred, and eight new decisions fix the shape of the next version.
